item.description: MARRAKECH — Rian Johnson has spent the past few years turning the whodunit into a global franchise. item.description: Convicted cryptocurrency fraudster Sam Bankman-Fried may be serving a 25-year prison sentence for orchestrating one of the largest financial frauds in American history. It’s a curious admission from a man convicted of stealing billions in customer funds, particularly given his continued refusal to accept responsibility.
